summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K designating May 8, 2026 as the record date for interim (quarterly) cash dividends for Q1 2026 under Article 60 of its articles of incorporation; no per-share amount, total payout, or payment date specified, though dividends are declared by board resolution within 45 days of quarter-end; this is a routine capital-return event on a non-US issuer's home-country schedule, analogous to a US dividend-announcement 8-K; shareholders as of the record date are entitled; no valuation or regulatory complexity; watch for the actual dividend declaration and amount.
